title: List of book vertices
statement: For natural numbers $q$ and $k$, list the vertices of the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part by taking the canonical list of $	ext{Fin}(qk)$ and transporting it back along the bijection between that set and the graph's vertices.
